SELECT m.material_name AS materialName, pod.requested_qty AS requestedQty, CAST(COALESCE(pod.approved_qty, 0) AS SIGNED) AS approvedQty,
COALESCE(SUM(bs.current_qty), 0) AS currentStock, COALESCE(bmss.safe_stock_qty, 0) AS safetyStock, po.reject_reason AS rejectReason,
m.unit AS unit
FROM place_order_detail pod
JOIN place_order po ON pod.po_id = po.po_id
JOIN material m ON pod.material_code = m.material_code
LEFT JOIN branch_stock bs ON bs.material_code = pod.material_code AND bs.branch_code = po.branch_code
LEFT JOIN branch_material_safety_stock bmss ON bmss.material_code = pod.material_code AND bmss.branch_code = po.branch_code
WHERE pod.po_id = #{poId}
GROUP BY m.material_name, pod.requested_qty, pod.approved_qty, bmss.safe_stock_qty, po.reject_reason, m.unit
